items.note: The complete tragédie en musique, with a prologue and five acts, on two CDs, released on 9 February 2024. The track list opens with the Ouverture, 3:44, and lists the dances of the prologue separately.

items.work: Pièces de clavecin — suites from the books of 1687 and 1707
items.label: Auvidis
items.note: The recording has twenty-six tracks. The set opens with the D minor suite of 1687, from the Prélude to the Chaconne l’Inconstante, which runs 3:28 here, and continues with the G minor suite and later suites.

links.title: Les pièces de clavecin on Apple Music

items.label: Outhere
items.note: All six sonatas, each movement listed separately. The movement headings include Lent, Presto, Adagio and Aria, with a Courante in the fifth sonata and an Allemande in the sixth.

items.note: Two cantatas, two harpsichord pieces and a sonata for violin and continuo in D minor. The Sommeil movement of Le Sommeil d’Ulisse lasts 7:52.
